doc: The wake header's words: the one-line label and the message under it for each turn_wake shape.
internal/marotte WakeLine and WakeSearchTexts are the server readers (the rail's first line, the
Markdown export and find-in-chat) and static-src/turn-wake.ts wakeLine the client's (the header, the
rail and Copy as text); both read these cases, so a wording change lands in both or fails one.
Expected values follow the approved wording, not either implementation. A run is named by the wake's
run_name, else "A workflow" until a run_named entry names it.
run and rest are where the client splits the label for its run button; rows are a re-delivery's
messages, each a run button then rest then the text. search is what the server indexes, which is
what the header draws (omitted where a case adds nothing to the other cases).
